propositions: The edit and claim subcommands require new --review flags that embed prerequisite plan-review verification in the consuming verb rather than requiring separate commands.
The edit --review flag must parse as a valueless flag, commit the EDIT event, invoke review_plan with signing, and exit with disposition codes (0 PASS, 1 BLOCK, 2 INDETERMINATE, 11 retryable).

The claim --review flag must sense gate applicability via shared _plan_review_gate_applies, call claim_gate_check and review_plan only when gate applies and attestation is not-ok, claim only on PASS verdict, and exit with appropriate disposition codes without cascading to parents.

The review_plan operation must not hold the store lock across the LLM pass, and any exception from review_plan must propagate through the standard CLI error handler with the edit committed but the claim never invoked.

Help documentation must state both flags are non-atomic against concurrent store reconvergence, reference review-plan --status, and the exit-codes documentation must capture the new disposition mappings while preserving unchanged flagless contracts.
